    The SNLL fire-size threshold of the objective function, for the years in covs

    estimateSNLLThresholdPostLargeFires.Rd

    Uses SNLL_FS_thresh if supplied; otherwise calibrates it with a cached runSpreadWithoutDEoptim() call on covs. The threshold bounds the summed SNLL of the two largest fire years of the data it is used on, so it belongs to those years: a cross-validation fold calibrates its own (fitAndScoreFold()).

    estimateSNLLThresholdPostLargeFires(sim, covs)

    Arguments

    sim

    a simList, after spreadFitPrep().

    covs

    mod$covsX1000, or the subset of its years that will be fitted.

    Value

    the threshold; Inf (no early stop) if every calibration trial failed, see noEarlyStopThreshold().
